name: NFT Factory
description: Configure a NEP-11 collection from an audited on-chain template — set a marketplace-honored royalty and a transferable/soulbound policy, then deploy via the platform Factory. You pay only the Neo network fee, no app fee. Deploy is available on networks where a factory admin has preloaded the artifact; on other networks you sign and export a portable plan.
description_zh: 基于已审计链上模板配置 NEP-11 集合——设置市场遵循的版税与可转让/灵魂绑定策略，并通过平台 Factory 部署。只需支付 Neo 网络费用，没有应用费用。仅在 Factory 管理员已预置工件的网络上可部署；其他网络上可签名并导出可携带计划。

aa.description: Template plans can be submitted by AA later, but this standalone app does not require AA.

tee.description: No private computation is required for deterministic collection planning.

neodid.description: Creator identity can be layered on top by signing the generated template plan.
